justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId wrapping u64, well-defined JobState enum, typed QueueError variants, and a dedicated CheckedOut handle — every meaningful distinction has its own type.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinguishing variants and Display impl; the constructor panics on max_attempts==0 (documented) and an `expect` is used inside checkout with a clear reason, but saturating overflow fallbacks are reasonable.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface, doc comments on every public item, appropriate derives (Copy/Clone/Eq/Hash/Debug on JobId, PartialEq/Eq/Debug on JobState), Display on the error, and naming follows std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with `?`, `matches!`, iterator/sort use, and proper derives, but checkout collects+sorts all keys on every call and clones the payload rather than using a more efficient lookup or borrow strategy.
